{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Wall Charger, Surge Protector, QINLIANF 5 Outlet Extender with 4 USB Charging Ports (4.8A Total) 3-Sided 1680J Power Strip Multi Plug Adapter Spaced for Home Travel Office (3U1C); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for my TV and streaming setup, but I would pass without a clear need for more outlets.
ItemID: 2; Title: Anker Soundcore Liberty Air 2 Wireless Earbuds, Diamond-Inspired Drivers, Bluetooth Earphones, 4 Mics, Noise Reduction, 28H Playtime, HearID, Bluetooth 5, Wireless Charging, for Calls, Home Office; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent interests center on home viewing and security, with no clear interest in earbuds right now.
ItemID: 3; Title: amFilm Screen Protector for iPad Mini 5/iPad Mini 4, Tempered Glass, 1 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no indicated iPad Mini to use this with.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Fire TV use makes Alexa familiar, but I have no current reason to add it to my car.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Studio | Glacier White with Sengled Bluetooth Color Bulb | Alexa smart home starter kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in connected home electronics, but a speaker and bulb bundle is not a clear priority today.
ItemID: 6; Title: SAMSUNG 980 PRO SSD 2TB PCIe NVMe Gen 4 Gaming M.2 Internal Solid State Drive Memory Card + 2mo Adobe CC Photography, Maximum Speed, Thermal Control (MZ-V8P2T0B); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Owning a monitor does not give me a reason to buy an internal SSD, and I have no indicated upgrade need.
ItemID: 7; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to explore broader home camera coverage; my previous Blink and Foscam purchases make it especially relevant, though some equipment could overlap.
ItemID: 8; Title: JOUNIVO USB Microphone for Computer, PC/Laptop Mic, Mute Button with LED Indicator, 360 Degree Gooseneck Design, Desktop Microphone for Streaming, Recording, Dictation, Podcasting, YouTube, JV610; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camcorder purchase alone does not suggest I need a desktop microphone or podcasting setup.
ItemID: 9; Title: TP-Link AC1750 Smart WiFi Router (Archer A7) -Dual Band Gigabit Wireless Internet Router for Home, Works with Alexa, VPN Server, Parental Control, QoS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Networking supports my streaming devices and cameras, but I would only buy a router if my current connection needed improvement.
ItemID: 10; Title: Neewer 2 Pieces Light Stand Kit, 102"/260cm Stainless Steel Heavy Duty with 1/4" to 3/8" Adapter for Studio Softbox, Monolight and Other Photographic Equipment; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My portable camcorder interest does not establish a need for studio lighting stands."}
